properties.summary: Incident Type: MOBILE - NRC Report ID: 902348 - Medium Affected: SOIL - Suspected Responsible Party: TOWNSEND AVIATION, INC.
properties.content:
NRC Report ID: 902348
Incident Time: 2008-07-31 17:00:00
Nearest City: Monticello, IN
Incident Type: MOBILE
Material: JET FUEL: JP-4
Medium Affected: SOIL
Suspected Responsible Party: TOWNSEND AVIATION, INC.
Skytruth Analysis
Reported Spill Volume: 200 gallons
I JUST DISCOVERED THIS SITE, OR I WOULD HAVE POSTED THIS PREVIOUSLY. LAST SUMMER (I DON'T KNOW THE EXACT DATE) A JET FUEL TANK TRUCK PARKED NEAR A WATERSHED LEADING TO LAKE FREEMAN APPARENTLY LEAKED FOR SOME REASON. THE DEAD ZONE IN THE GRASS WAS TENS OF FEET SQUARE. I UNDERSTAND THAT A PERSON FROM INDIANA DEPT. OF ENVIRONMENTAL MANAGEMENT VISITED THE SCENE. SUBSEQUENTLY, ON A FRIDAY EVENING, WITH THE IDEM PERSON ABSENT, AN EXCAVATOR LOADED A NUMBER OF DUMP TRUCKS WITH THE CONTAMINATED SOIL AND DUMPED IT ACROSS THE ROAD, INTO A RAVINE, WHERE AN INDIVIDUAL WAS SEEKING FILL. THIS RAVINE HAS A STREAM WHICH IS ONLY SEVERAL HUNDRED FEET TO LAKE FREEMAN. IN MY EXPERIENCE, EVEN SMALLER SPILLS LIKE THIS WERE REQUIRED TO BE PLACED IN A DESIGNATED SPOT IN THE LAND FILL.

properties.summary: Incident Type: FIXED - NRC Report ID: 1387291 - Medium Affected: WATER - Suspected Responsible Party: U.S. FOREST SERVICE
properties.content:
Report Details
NRC Report ID: 1387291
Incident Time: 2023-12-21 15:00:00
Nearest City: Thorne Bay, AK
Location: 1212 FEDERAL WAY
Location2: THORNE BAY RANGER DISTRICT
Incident Type: FIXED
Material: LEAD
Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party: U.S. FOREST SERVICE
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 55.688918, -132.529197 (Approximated from street_address)
Report DescriptionCALLER REPORTS APPROXIMATELY 20 APARTMENT AND DUPLEXES ARE BEING AFFECTED BY LEAD AND COPPER IN THE THEIR DRINKING WATER. IN 2006 WATER TESTING WAS DONE AND PROVED THAT LEAD AND COPPER WERE PRESENT IN THE WATER IN THE LIVING AREAS AND WORK SPACE. TESTS INDICATED THAT THERE WERE 2-3 TIMES THE LEGAL LIMITS OF THESE MATERIALS PRESENT. NOTHING WAS DONE TO MITIGATE THE ISSUE. IN 2010 WATER FILTERS WERE PROVIDED BUT STAFF AND FAMILIES WERE NEVER NOTIFIED OF THE TESTING, NO OTHER INFORMATION WAS PROVIDED TO INDIVIDUALS WHEN THE FILTER WERE INSTALLED NO MAINTENANCE PLANS WERE SET TO REGULARLY CHANGE THEM. SOME FILTERS HAVE NOT BEEN CHANGED SINCE DATE OF INSTALLATION. IN 2019 TESTS WERE CONDUCTED AGAIN AND AGAIN NO ONE WAS INFORMED OF THE ISSUE. RECENTLY EVERYONE WAS INFORMED THAT THEY NEED TO STOP DRINKING THE WATER. THEY WILL NOT BE ABLE TO RUN TESTS ON THE WATER AGAIN FOR ANOTHER 6 WEEKS. THE AREA IS REMOTE AND INDIVIDUALS WILL DO NOT HAVE OTHER OPTIONS TO FIND OTHER SOURCES OF WATER. HEALTH ISSUES HAVE ARISEN IN THE COMMUNITY THAT MAY BE DUE TO THE LEAD AND COPPER IN THE WATER. STAFF WILL NOT BE COVERED TO OBTAIN BLOOD TEST, IT WILL BE AN OUT OF POCKET COST TO THEM UNTIL FUNDING CAN BE IDENTIFIED. THE DAMAGES AMOUNT IS CURRENTLY UNKNOWN.

Report Description
///NESDIS MARINE POLLUTION SURVEILLANCE REPORT.///THIS OIL WAS DETECTED FROM A REPEAT LEAK SOURCE. THERE IS ALSO AN NRC REPORT FROM MAY 13TH THAT CONFIRMS THE SLICK (NRC REPORT #1082638) ORIENTATION AND LENGTH. THEREFORE LITTLE UNCERTAINTY EXISTS THAT THIS IS OIL. AN OIL SLICK WAS DETECTED ORIGINATING FROM THE DESTROYED TAYLOR PLATFORM, EXTENDING MAINLY TO THE WEST ALMOST 9 MILES. THERE WERE THREE DISTINCT SEGMENTS OF OIL WITH THE LONGEST AND WIDEST SEGMENT CONNECTED DIRECTLY WITH THE PLATFORM. THIS MAIN SEGMENT WAS 4 MILES IN LENGTH AND ABOUT .02 MILES IN WIDE. THERE WAS A FAINT OIL SIGNATURE IN THE IMAGERY THAT SUGGEST THAT THE OIL SLICK IS CONTINUOUS AND NOT BROKEN INTO SEGMENTS BUT CONFIDENCE WAS NOT AS HIGH WHEN ANALYZING THOSE PORTIONS OF THE OIL.
